bio: Research Overview Contact Us In our HSCI/Hem-Onc Flow Cytometry Laboratory, everyday I have the opportunity to work with and assist over 200+ brilliant Longwood area scientists. We treat every experiment with utmost care and diligence and we are always available to assist, advise or consult to better the outcome of every experiment that comes our way. Professional History I have been employed in the academic setting since 1995, working with esteemed scientists such as Dr. Peter C. Doherty, Dr. Gary D. Gilliland, and Dr. Benjamin Ebert assisting on laboratory and flow cytometry management. I also have expertise with murine models and am proficient in all aspects of murine studies.
